subject: EDIT: translator speed patches in BOTH pin working trees (fold + decode reuse + fingerprint memo); iOS bridge fat LTO; rebuilding shared host cdylib now
body: Pin working trees (references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin and build/metal2vulkan, HEAD 720ef1c, uncommitted): const_loads.rs fold (d3731920 patch) + compile.rs decode_reused + profile.rs fingerprint memo. compiler-speed's decode_reused adopted with one change for exactness: the reused decode charges the caller's Meter exactly what the decode costs (work units via tick, ledger peak via charge then release to the held bytes), measured once under the decode's own unlimited meter; otherwise a cache hit skipped the decode's work/ledger charges and the deterministic LimitExceeded caps could refuse/accept differently depending on process history. Equivalence: 17-record c6jb corpus 34/34 cache entries byte-identical vs fold-only. Combined patch for root's commit: gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/translator-compile-speed-combined.patch (2a732933; = translator-const-loads-fold.patch d3731920 + translator-decode-reuse-metered.patch 8a34db08). ROOT: commit in both translator checkouts + bump PIN in metal/tegu/build_air_bridge.py. metal/tegu/build_air_bridge.py: [profile.release] lto="fat", codegen-units=1 (panic stays unwind). FunctionCompileKey reuse in air_bridge.rs: NOT done - computing render_pipeline_key decodes+specializes both stages (the 77% part of a fixed_frag miss), so it only pays when it hits (~9% of corpus misses) and costs a second specialization on every other miss unless the key's kept entries feed the compile; I will look at it after the rebuilds. Sequence now (jobs1): shared host cdylib + cargo test 34 + producer receipt -> host Mali lib (be411e7a prefold) -> native Rust (LTO) + native Mali (incremental, no --wipe) -> full gates.
